title: xAPI development paid for by the Department of Defense. Go ask ten sergeants if they want their lieutenants carrying data that can only be reassembled
summary: xAPI development paid for by the Department of Defense. Go ask ten sergeants if they want their lieutenants carrying data that can only be reassembled using government provided devices or data packaged in human readable text. See what they say.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
xAPI development paid for by the Department of Defense.

Go ask ten sergeants if they want their lieutenants carrying data that can only be reassembled using government provided devices or data packaged in human readable text.

See what they say.
